published The source collection contains district-specific institution-registration copies. Four selected originals are documented below; the September handout groups the broader collection. These are separate institution records, not one nationwide DDEW licence. A network count should not be treated as proof that all centres hold current registrations. Original source: Recognitions bundle, pp96–124; September handout, physical p12.
